title: St. James deny-buy against cash leader
description: St. James deny-buy against cash leader. Buying St. James prevents the leader from buying orange cheaply in auction. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.
